content: {"hypothesis": "The writes come from tpautoconnsvc.exe (ThinPrint AutoConnect, part of VMware Tools) creating printer-redirection PPD files, which looks benign, but the cmd.exe /c alert is still unexplained, so its child processes need checking to see whether cmd.exe was spawned for routine printer setup or for something malicious.", "attack_likelihood": 0.1, "choice": 0}
